text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
My body feels so heavy...! It's as if I'm 
wearing a suit of armor...!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"...As I thought, stuffing myself with 
daifuku is the cause..."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Do not panic. A problem of this degree is 
child's play compared to battle.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Now then, I wonder what sort of plan I 
should devise—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Using my head makes me a little hungry... 
At times like this, a daifuku is—"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: I know that! I was just saying it!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Azuki beans or soybeans, a bean is still a 
bean! In that case, I shall eat natto for 
a while!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, No Reason stuck with the natto 
diet and succeeded brilliantly in losing 
weight.
